recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce ElementDefinition.name into current source; any recurrence of the old DSTU2 generation defect would be historical publication/tooling work outside this current-build reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-12494 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 change request reporting that spreadsheet-generated StructureDefinitions did not populate ElementDefinition.name for sliced elements, which blocked re-slicing; the Jira application comment says rendering was improved and the spreadsheet corrected.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-12494 implementation commit was found in this checkout. The Jira comment records that the historical DSTU2 spreadsheet/rendering correction was applied, while current source shows active profile spreadsheets and the current ElementDefinition field is sliceName rather than the old name element.
additional_context: ElementDefinition.name was renamed to ElementDefinition.sliceName by commit c997080bc43c87c6a1c22e4ac6b06a2cb0cdcf40, and current profiling prose describes re-slicing using ElementDefinition.sliceName. Active [profiles] entries in source/fhir.ini still include spreadsheet-backed profile sources, so the relevant current source was checked.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already defines ElementDefinition.sliceName, current profile spreadsheets retain a Profile Name column used for slicing/code generation, and the profiling guide explains re-slicing in terms of sliceName.
